_comment: Carve-out sidecar for signoff/verify-pin-restatements.py (issue #408). A klt-context version mention in tracked prose is a restatement finding unless an exemption here covers it. Kinds: 'file' (whole file), 'prefix' (everything under a directory), 'marker' (any line containing 'marker' as a substring), 'region' (the line span from the line containing 'start' through the next line containing 'end', inclusive). Every entry carries the reason it is legitimate; the legitimate classes are dated history, provenance/report quotation, the canonical grader-pin statement, and its install lines. Live restatements of a pin value are NOT legitimate: point at the declaration instead (the convention #363/#364 ratified and this guard enforces). The guard fails on entries whose file, marker or region no longer exists, so prune them when prose changes.

exemptions.reason: append-only dated work log: each entry is a historical record of what a PR or issue did at a point in time, not a live claim about today's pins
living planning queue: entries name pin-move tasks to execute (#204), not current-state documentation
bench/campaign docs under sim/ quote the exact toolchain each committed run used (dated run records and report quotations; append-only evidence)
dated, append-only decision records: campaigns record the toolchain they ran under
